scope: local POSIX process: event read/parse/rebuild only; not complete handoff
rules: Limits are proposed engineering acceptance budgets calibrated to these local samples, not production SLOs.
Runtime enforcement must be implemented and fault-tested before the capability is enabled.
Memory budget is whole fresh-process peak RSS acceptance, not a per-call or OS-enforced memory cap.
Resource exhaustion/limit breach => unknown and no handoff commit; do not truncate evidence.
Byte/event limits must be enforced during reading, not only from initial stat.
Deadline is an implementation requirement, not achieved by a post-hoc timer.
Host creation, verification of external evidence and full cold start need separate host budgets.
Monitor path must add zero model calls, zero brief calls, zero full event replays; repeat one sample 20 times without duplicate state writes.
future_index_trigger: After representative workloads and environment are pinned: >=3/5 fresh-process runs exceed a budget after eliminating avoidable duplicate reads/copies, or resource exhaustion. Evaluate B; do not auto-deploy.
